title: Kneeling in Patterned Room
description: A woman with short dark hair kneels on a black and white patterned rug in a retro-styled living room. She wears a dark blue ruffled top, denim shorts, and blue thigh-high boots, posed with one hand on the floor beside an orange sofa and a decorative white stool.
prompt: A woman with short black hair kneeling on a black and white patterned rug inside a 1970s style living room with wood paneling and large windows overlooking a lake. She wears a dark blue ruffled cut-out top, denim shorts, and matching blue thigh-high boots. An orange sofa with patterned pillows sits behind her, a white ornate stool to the right. Bold blue and white abstract squiggly line overlays float across the image, creating a surreal collage effect.
